purpose: One browser JMdict screen for each independent compression-acknowledgment and record-finalization candidate. Local Node wall/CPU variance was inconclusive, and synchronous Node filesystem writes do not model browser asynchronous finalization.
fixtureIntegrity: Locked SHA-256 required before every observation
timingBoundary: Browser monotonic file-input change through completed import UI; separate memory observations are not timing evidence
controls: Existing two warmups per arm, six alternating complete candidate pairs and two interleaved identical-code A/C pairs in each independent initial-order cell
failurePolicy: One fixed browser screen per candidate; retain every scheduled observation and failure, without replacement, tail trimming or repetitions to chase noise
decisionPolicy: No PR without useful replicated complete-import improvement beyond identical-code controls, unchanged semantics/storage and every validation and prospective memory gate passing. Keep AB and BA hosts separate and assess benefit against implementation complexity.
memoryPolicy: Unchanged qualification gate: all observations covered; paired median PSS/private increases at most 5%, individual pairs at most 10%
semanticPolicy: Unchanged exhaustive media, JMdict no-media, canonical content, reopened storage, source/package identity and normal parser-worker gates
evidencePolicy: Upload registered plans, exact source-tree receipts, qualification observations/packages/logs and validation logs/fixture reports only; exclude qualification-sources worktrees and dependencies
